Bug_Details: Splitting log statements and using Api instances directly breaks logging.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by splitting the log statement into two parts. When the logger evaluates the expression, it will log the string 'User ID:'and not include the user ID value. This is because the logger.info() method is called before the user ID is appended to the message string.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the `showBug` method which causes the log statement to be split. As described in the bug explanation, this split log statement triggers the bug, causing the wrong value to be logged.
